name: PharmaSight Platform Integration Testing
description: Automated testing and deployment verification for PharmaSight drug discovery platform

tasks.name: Setup Environment
steps: Create .env file in project root with required API keys
Create .env file in admin-dashboard/ for TypeScript services
Verify Docker and Docker Compose are available
Install Node.js dependencies for admin dashboard

tasks.name: Test Ketamine Analog Pipeline
tasks.description: Verify patent boundary classification and 3D conformer generation

tasks.name: Test BioTransformer Service
tasks.description: Verify metabolite prediction service in mock mode
steps: Wait 10 seconds for service to start
Test prediction endpoint with ketamine SMILES
Verify mock mode response includes metabolites

tasks.name: Setup Databases
steps: Wait 30 seconds for databases to initialize
Verify MySQL is ready: docker-compose exec mysql mysqladmin ping
Verify PostgreSQL is ready: docker-compose exec postgres pg_isready
Verify Redis is ready: docker-compose exec redis redis-cli ping

tasks.name: Setup Admin Dashboard
tasks.description: Install dependencies and run database migrations
steps: Wait 15 seconds for server to start

tasks.name: Test Python Microservices
tasks.description: Start and verify all Python microservices
steps: docker-compose up -d compound-service analog-service ml-service quantum-calculator auth-service api-gateway pophive-connector
Wait 30 seconds for all services to start

tasks.name: Test Multi-LLM Chatbot
tasks.description: Verify chatbot functionality in admin dashboard
steps: Test sample query: 'What are the top 5 analogs?'
Verify chatbot responds with analog data
Test different LLM providers if API keys available

tasks.name: End-to-End Discovery Workflow
steps: Submit to ADMET prediction via admin dashboard API
Verify analog appears in admin dashboard

tasks.name: Verify Autonomous Research Engine
tasks.description: Test autonomous research scheduler and PubMed integration
steps: Test research engine directly: python3 server/python_modules/autonomous_research_engine.py --goals 'NMDA antagonists' --max-api-calls 5

tasks.name: Performance & Load Testing
steps: Run batch analog generation test (10 compounds)
Test BioTransformer batch endpoint with 5 compounds
Check response times for API endpoints
Verify no memory leaks or crashes

tasks.name: Generate Test Report
tasks.description: Document all test results and issues
steps: Compile test results from all tasks
List missing dependencies or configuration issues
List API response times and performance metrics

commonIssues.solution: Wait 30 seconds after docker-compose up for MySQL to initialize
Use Node.js version 18 or higher. Try: nvm install 18 && nvm use 18
Service runs in mock mode without JAR file. Check for 'mock_mode: true' in response
Stop conflicting services: docker-compose down && fuser -k 3000/tcp 8080/tcp

commonIssues.issue: RDKit import errors in ketamine pipeline
